# trademark holder

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:trademarkHolder`](gmeow-trademarkHolder.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/trademarkHolder>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The agent that holds a trademark (the proprietor). A specialisation of [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md). Non-functional: a mark may be jointly held.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:trademarkHolder`](gmeow-trademarkHolder.md) from [`gmeow:Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md), [`gmeow:Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attribute a trademark to its proprietor agent(s) — the trademark-side rights-holder attribution, reusing [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a parallel hasHolder property (this specialises [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md)) and avoid collapsing joint proprietors into one — co-equal holders coexist, so it is non-functional.

### How to use

- Add one or more [`gmeow:trademarkHolder`](gmeow-trademarkHolder.md) agents to a [`Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md) (non-functional for joint holdings), mirroring [`gmeow:copyrightHolder`](gmeow-copyrightHolder.md) on the copyright side.

### Examples

- ex:blackcatTM [`gmeow:trademarkHolder`](gmeow-trademarkHolder.md) ex:blackcat.
